website.description: A Dalamud FFXIV Plugin for adding and controlling an unlimited number of additional hotbars.
website.readmeExcerpt:
# Expanded Hotbars

This is a plugin for FFXIV/Dalamud that allows you to create and manage an unlimited number of additional hotbars built into the games native ui!

You can manage various show conditions to make certain bars only appear in certain places in the game, or when playing certain jobs, or many many other conditions!

variant.author: MidoriKami
variant.changelog:
First stable release!

Expanded hotbars allows you to add and control an unlimited number of real-ingame hotbars. With various conditions available to automatically show or hide hotbars as needed!

Also features import and export capabilities to easily share or save your hotbar configurations.
